title: My SIL Forged My Name, Stole My Seeds, Sold Them For $480K. So I Made Her Pack Envelopes.
description: After I poured my nursing pension into a heirloom seed library, my sister-in-law forged a dissolution document, claimed my contribution was a gift, and sold the entire collection to a bio-agriculture giant. I proved the forgery with texts and bank records, won the full intellectual property rights, and now she packs seeds for my company under a federal garnishment order, every envelope stamped “Sown from Fraud.” #RevengeStory #SeedLibrary #FamilyBetrayal
thumb_text: SHE FORGED MY NAME, NOW SHE PACKS MY SEEDS.
pinned_comment: If your sister-in-law stole your $95,000 retirement and sold your heirloom seed library for $480,000, would you have made her work for you packing envelopes, or would you have walked away? Tell me what you would have done in the comments.
